activity.notes: Own-side political-community Activity for Yu Gwan-sun. 'Korea under Japanese Rule' / '일제강점기 조선' is an ATLAS editorial catalog label for the non-sovereign Korean/Choson historical community under Japanese colonial rule, not an official state name and not the Empire of Japan or the Government-General of Korea. The March First Declaration explicitly declared Choson (朝鮮) an independent country and Choson people (朝鮮人) a self-governing people. The existing Empire of Japan / opposes Activity remains the counterparty relationship; this Activity supplies the representative own-side Polity without erasing colonial jurisdiction or opposition history.

sources.title: 3·1 독립선언서 — 한국독립운동사자료
sources.citation_text: The March First Declaration states '我朝鮮의 獨立國임과 朝鮮人의 自主民임을 宣言', explicitly identifying Choson and Choson people as the political subject of independence.

sources.title: 일제강점기(1910~1945) — 우리역사넷
sources.citation_text: The National Institute of Korean History periodizes 1910–1945 as 일제강점기 and describes Joseon/Choson and Joseon people under Japanese colonial rule as a distinct historical society and people subject to colonial policy.
